case.pattern_description: Automated sub-threshold velocity stacking attack. Coordinated bot executed six sequential charges across distinct digital gift card and remittance merchants within a 12-minute window, systematically calibrating each charge between $460 and $495 to evade single-transaction $500 friction thresholds.
connected_device_profiles: Android 8.0 | NativeApp API Client | Automation Script

evidence.claim: Transaction 3598720 ($495.00) is part of a burst of 6 rapid authorizations across 6 separate merchant codes (MCC 5947, 5999, 6051) within 12 minutes.
TigerGraph pattern analysis confirms sub-threshold structuring intentionally designed to remain below automated $500 hard-decline triggers.
Customer reported mobile phone stolen 2 hours prior and denied initiating any digital gift card purchases.
Activity fits none of the 5 standard categories but demonstrates coordinated sub-threshold abuse across merchants under Policy R9.

sar.reason: R9 and R2: Undocumented coordinated velocity stacking attack with multi-merchant draining totaling $2,875.00, exceeding regulatory filing threshold.
sar.narrative: Between 19:58 and 20:10 UTC on 2016-12-23, card C03892-K2 belonging to customer C03892 was subjected to a coordinated, high-velocity sub-threshold fraud attack. An automated script executed six rapid charges totaling $2,875.00 across six distinct digital merchant endpoints (including gift card exchanges and digital remittance platforms), deliberately structuring each transaction between $460.00 and $495.00 to evade single-transaction velocity rules. Emergency cardholder contact confirmed the physical device and card data were compromised. Pursuant to Bank Policy R9 for undocumented coordinated abuse and FinCEN advisory standards, card C03892-K2 has been terminated under L2 authority, primary card C03892-K1 placed under surveillance, and this SAR is submitted to report coordinated structuring and automated card draining.

stop_reason: Novel coordinated fraud pattern confirmed and contained. Rule R9 mandates applied, SAR filed, and case escalated to intelligence team.
